artifact_requirement: Each answer must deliver the requested 300-450-word reader-facing passage before any audit note. An accurate checklist, refusal, or diagnostic without the requested artifact is a hard failure. An optional audit note may follow and must not exceed 80 words.
safety_rule: A hard failure independently named by both judges on the same case and response is confirmed and disqualifying; a single-judge flag requires blind adjudication.
comparison_rule: CodexEssaySkill may be described as higher on Publication-Craft-12 only if it exceeds ClaudeEssaySkill by at least 2.0 points and has no more confirmed hard failures.
tie_rule: Differences below 2.0 points are no practical difference.
missing_rule: Any missing case, response, judge score, or dimension makes the comparison INCOMPLETE.
